title: devkb says my CI script does not exist
body:
**What I did:** my repository has a Python script at `.github/scripts/deploy.py` with a few functions. I asked `devkb outline .github/scripts/deploy.py` and `devkb symbol .github/scripts/deploy.py::release`.

**What I got:** "no tracked file with symbols by that path" and "no symbol", although the file is committed and the graph was built after it.

**What I expected:** the outline of the file and the function, as for any other file.
